AES Main Event
The AES Main Event will feature insightful panel discussions and interactive Q&A sessions with industry leaders, practitioners, government officials, and academics, focusing on critical topics such as domestic energy resilience, cutting-edge technological innovations, and forward-thinking policy frameworks.
Panel Session
Domestic Energy Resilience Strategies
Exploring strategies to strengthen domestic energy resilience by addressing current and future challenges in meeting national production targets.
New Innovative Technology
Spotlighting groundbreaking technological innovations that are redefining the energy industry, featuring cutting-edge technologies and best practices.
Career in the Energy Industry
Valuable insights into the current state and future trends of careers in the energy industry, exploring the evolving roles of energy professionals.
